question: Where writes-off and the committed 3x2 table disagree on the 62 ko-sensitive (slot,side) pairs, which one is right?
answer: Writes-off, on 62 of 62 adjudicable pairs. The 807d530 artifact generation is refuted on all 62; writes-off on none. The adjudicator is the minimax identity under a fixed root history (ADR-0013), not the history-exact solver, which resolved 0 of 62.

807d530.role: the audit's 'old'; the 62 are against this

reproduction.shortfall: The audit's third method ('new', MTD + bounds memo, empty goban -2) is not reproducible from any committed artifact -- no committed 3x2 .wzo carries -2 at idx 0. It reproduces only as a live code path: memo_writes=ON yields parent=-2 best-option=0 at idx 0 Black, which identifies 'new' with cross-branch memo reuse.

controls.order: Every null control ran BEFORE the adjudication it calibrates (acceptance item 3).

null_history_exact_on_agreeing.note: The history-exact judge could not be calibrated at all -- it resolved none of its own null-control pairs.

known_bad_generator_control.description: The convicted memo_writes=ON table is a REAL seeded defect (ADR-0013). Adjudicate every pair where it differs from writes-off.

controls.instrument_defect_the_null_control_caugh: The first cut of the identity adjudicator seeded its search context from the FINISHED writes-off table, marking every ko-sensitive slot as a clean history-free memo entry -- the exact reuse under audit. Null control: 52 disagreements of 316, and a plausible-looking 42/20 split on the 62. Re-seeding from the certified-only table (seed/converge/finalize, no finisher), as retro.zig:2984 does, took the null control to 316/316 and the verdict to 62/0. Had the control run after the adjudication, this row would have shipped the 42/20.

history_exact.growth_verdict: 0.541 new ban-set states per node, flat across five doublings, no plateau. Extrapolating 74 B/node, the 400M-node escalation needs about 29.6 GB -- and 400M nodes did not resolve it, so that is a lower bound on an unknown cost.
history_exact.reading: 3x2.EXACT (Finding 3: 68 of 600 roots) read correctly -- the roots that complete are the settled ones, and every ko-sensitive slot is unsettled (L<H) by definition.

brackets_and_symmetry.why_these: src/retro.zig:2637 -- 'Ko-sensitive region is NOT spot-checked here: forward search cannot tractably reach it (Finding 3/6) -- it is validated by the [L,H] brackets + symmetry instead.'
brackets_and_symmetry.zero_discriminating_power: writes-off and memo-reuse differ on 170 of 378 pairs, so at most one can be right -- and brackets plus symmetry accept BOTH tables completely, 0 violations each. The two validators the engine names for this region cannot detect a generator ADR-0013 has already proven buggy.

minimax_identity.instrument: V(P,side,[P]) == opt over children V(c,-side,[P,c]) and the pass branch; ADR-0013 / docs/research/consistency-audit.md
minimax_identity.why_retro_consist_could_not_answer_this_: RETRO_CONSIST audits a GENERATOR -- it solves the parent with the variant under test. The generator that produced the 62 disputed values is not in the repository any more. This row computes only the identity's right-hand side (children and pass branch re-solved independently under H=[P,c] by the sound variant) and tests BOTH candidate parent values against it.

overlap_with_the_45.note: On none of the 17 does the 807d530 value equal the memo-ON parent value -- the old artifact is a third generation, distinct from both live variants.

minimax_identity.assumption: Children and pass branch are valued by the sound finisher variant (memo_writes=false) reading certified seeds and [L,H] brackets over the real positional-superko history. A refutation says 'this stored value contradicts the sound solver's independently re-solved children one ply deeper', not 'this value is false in the absolute'. Same standing as the ADR-0013 conviction, applied to numbers instead of to a code path.

both_wrong_check.asked_by: acceptance item 4 -- a pair refuting BOTH methods would indict the [L,H] brackets or the certified seeds beneath them
both_wrong_check.verdict: Four independent opportunities tested, all four empty. Brackets and certified seeds are not implicated at 3x2 on this evidence. (The history-exact line is vacuous -- it resolved nothing.)

what_this_licenses: Writes-off is right on 62 of 62 adjudicable pairs; the 807d530 values are refuted on all 62.
Across the whole region, writes-off equals the independently re-solved best option at 378 of 378 ko-sensitive pairs.
The dependency-guarded (Track B) generator agrees with writes-off at 378/378 and 978/978 and is self-consistent at 0/378.
Cross-branch memo reuse is refuted at 45 of 378 by the project's own auditor and at 170 of 170 of its disagreements here.
what_this_does_not_license: No independent oracle resolved a single disputed pair. retro.Exact returned 0 of 62 and 0 of 24. Everything above is a NECESSARY test; consistency-audit.md says a solver can be self-consistent at a wrong fixpoint and the identity never yields the true score.

'Writes-off is the correct generator' remains unproven. What is established: of the candidates testable at 3x2, writes-off is the only one not refuted, and the artifact generation it replaced is refuted on every disputed slot.

The identity's right-hand side is computed by the sound variant, so it shares that variant's dependence on bracket validity, certified-seed history-freeness and eye-prune soundness -- weaker than trusting the whole writes-off table, but not zero.
Nothing here transfers to 4x4 by itself. It removes an objection to Track A; it does not discharge the 4x4 tractability question.
This row proposes no claim status change and edits no register, per the brief.

track_a_premise_at_3x2.evidence: artifacts/oracle-3x2.wzo at HEAD agrees with a fresh writes-off rebuild on all 978 (slot,side) values, and its SHA-256 matches artifacts/SHA256SUMS. The 62 were repaired by the regeneration at ae39978, the same commit that landed ADR-0013.
track_a_premise_at_3x2.caveat: This says the numbers on disk are the writes-off numbers. It is not evidence that the regeneration was verified at the time, and it settles nothing at 4x4.

cost_comparison.asked_by: the bundle amendment -- 'if the existing tooling makes this cheap, say by how much'
cost_comparison.speedup: about 690x faster and 460x less memory, with the answer instead of without it. The reproduce-plus-controls stage costs 12 ms of generator time.
cost_comparison.honest_other_half: The existing tooling does NOT make the history-exact route cheap. Zig buys nothing there: the engine's Exact solver hits the same wall for the same structural reason (0.541 new ban-set states per node, no reuse), at 74 bytes per node instead of a Python frame. The earlier attempts' error was choosing an intractable judge and then scaling the machine at it, not the language.

missing_instrument.name: a TABLE-level (artifact-level) minimax-identity check
missing_instrument.why: RETRO_CONSIST audits generators and cannot be pointed at a .wzo. That is why a fourth attempt was needed to adjudicate values the project's own instrument could have refuted in milliseconds since 2026-07-23.
missing_instrument.prototype: src/t912_adjudicate.zig phase 1b-2 -- load an artifact, take its stored value as the parent, test it against independently re-solved children.
missing_instrument.recommendation_for_the_operator: Promote it into the standing battery so every committed artifact's ko-sensitive region is identity-checked at commit time. This row does not make that decision.

instrument.engine_files_edited: none -- src/retro.zig, src/artifact.zig and src/managent/main.zig are untouched (one writer per engine file)
instrument.memory_discipline: One shared ban-set-keyed memo across all roots (sound; retro.zig:1738), bounded by ctx.entry_cap; per-root node budget in the groundTruth style; recursion on one spawned thread with an explicit 256 MB stack. This is what the three RSS deaths lacked.

notes: Inbox polled at four checkpoints (bin/managent inbox T912 --ack): empty every time, no directive IDs to record. No claim status proposed and no register edited, per the brief's constraint. All figures carry their denominator; committed paths only -- the 'old' artifact is extracted from git at 807d530, not read from any loose working-tree copy.
